fields.name: Login Reward Program
fields.summary: Reward customers the next time they login to your product.
fields.longDescription:
### Use Cases

The Login Reward Program is perfect for: 

- Reactivating customers
- Improving customer adoption rates
- Driving customer product engagement 

### Quickstart

1. Select the claim window for which you would like to offer rewards. 
 
2. Choose a value and reward type you would like to provide to the user for successfully logging in. 
 
3. Configure the email sent to customers who successfully earned a reward. (This email can also be disabled)
 
4. Enable the program from the Program Management screen.

### How it works
The Login Reward Program allow you to reward users who log into your product or service within a given time window. 

Engage with these inactive users by sending them an email offering them a reward if they log into your product or service.

When a user logs into your product within the given time window, a reward will be added to their account in the SaaSquatch system, and an email can be configured to be sent to them letting them know that they have earned a reward.

This reward can then be fulfilled through either your existing reward fulfillment process, or through additional steps you put in place for this program. 

### Required User Information
The Login Reward Program relies on the squatch.js Javascript Library or mobile SDK user upsert to be able to recognize that a user has opened/engaged with your product.  

Making sure to run this upsert method behind each time a user logs into your product will allow the program to correctly evaluate whether the user has opened/engaged with your product.

In order to be able to send the successful program participant an email informing them that they have earned a reward, please include the users email in the upsert.

### Supported Rewards
This program provides the power and flexibility to customize the type of reward that you would like to provide to participants who complete their profile. These include:
- Dollar Credit
- Percent Discount
- Points
- Custom Reward Code Fuel Tank
- Arbitrary Rewards
